i.norm: Verifies that inSorted finds an empty string when the array has 9 elements (triggering the binary-search code path instead of the linear scan used for arrays of length <= 8), and the empty string is placed at index 4 — the midpoint that binary search probes first — so the search succeeds even though all other array slots remain null.
9-element array exceeds the threshold of 8, so inSorted will use Arrays.binarySearch
Place the needle at index 4 (the binary-search midpoint for a 9-element array) so it is found on the very first probe without comparing against any null slot
